_comment: Pins the plugin's English copy of the Collaboration Agreement (includes/templates/collaboration-agreement-en.php), read from the Google Doc '[EN] Collaboration Agreement - WP Credits' whose modifiedTime is the version. 'sha256' is WPCPM_Agreement_Template::checksum() of the UNMERGED template, i.e. the sha256 of plain_text() with '[Institution Name]' still in place; 'placeholder_count' is how many times that token appears; 'blocks' is the block count; 'load_bearing' are the sentences the program relies on, each of which must be present verbatim. The rule: any edit to the agreement's text needs a version bump (to the Doc's new modified date) and a refresh of this file, together, in the same change. bin/test-agreement-template.php fails otherwise. Refresh by running the class against the edited template and copying its checksum here, never by editing the hash to match.
load_bearing: This document is not legally binding.

The Program is free of charge for both institutions and students.
